name: IsTangentAt.eq_of_isTangentAt
statement: Sphere P} {p q : P} {as : AffineSubspace ℝ P} (hp : s.IsTangentAt p as) (hq : s.IsTangentAt q as) : p = q

name: IsTangentAt.dist_eq_of_mem_of_mem
statement: Sphere P} {p₁ p₂ q : P} {as₁ as₂ : AffineSubspace ℝ P} (h₁ : s.IsTangentAt p₁ as₁) (h₂ : s.IsTangentAt p₂ as₂) (hq_mem₁ : q ∈ as₁) (hq_mem₂ : q ∈ as₂) : dist q p₁ = dist q p₂

name: IsTangentAt.eq_orthRadius_of_finrank_add_one_eq
statement: Sphere P} {as : AffineSubspace ℝ P} {p : P} (ht : s.IsTangentAt p as) (hr : s.radius ≠ 0) (hfr : Module.finrank ℝ as.direction + 1 = Module.finrank ℝ V) : as = s.orthRadius p

name: IsTangent.infDist_eq_radius
statement: Sphere P} {as : AffineSubspace ℝ P} (h : s.IsTangent as) : Metric.infDist s.center as = s.radius

name: IsTangent.eq_orthRadius_or_eq_orthRadius_pointReflection_of_parallel_orthRadius
statement: Sphere P} {as : AffineSubspace ℝ P} {p : P} (h : s.IsTangent as) (hpar : as ∥ s.orthRadius p) (hp : p ∈ s) : as = s.orthRadius p ∨ as = s.orthRadius (Equiv.pointReflection s.center p)

name: IsTangentAt.eq_orthogonalProjection
statement: Sphere P} {p : P} {as : AffineSubspace ℝ P} [Nonempty as] [as.direction.HasOrthogonalProjection] (h : s.IsTangentAt p as) : p = orthogonalProjection as s.center

name: isIntTangent_iff_dist_center
statement: Sphere P} : s₁.IsIntTangent s₂ ↔ dist s₁.center s₂.center = s₂.radius - s₁.radius ∧ 0 ≤ s₁.radius ∧ 0 ≤ s₂.radius
